_comment: Hand-maintained (data/ is hand-maintained; meta/ is generated - do not move this file).
Named DM32_KEYSEQ scripts, consumed by tools/src/dm32_patch_tools/keyseq_lib.py.
The raw keyseq grammar (cb:cbit:rb:rbit:hold:gap;... with -1 lead-ins) is documented in

probe.description: Wait for standby (lead-in, no key), MENU to the top-level menu, BACK to standby, then a short tail so the standby repaint after BACK settles. The default probe key script used by qemu_boot_diff / verify_patch.

snake-walkthrough.description: Codeplug-less Snake walkthrough: MENU, Up (wraps to SNAKE), OK (sub-list), OK (Play), four direction changes (2/4/6/8 keys), Back, Back. Produces the measured screen sequence 0, 580, (optional 2993), 13618, 13309, 9472, then game frames (1175 between direction changes) and the stock UI after Back (2993/2997).

menu-from-standby.description: Wait for standby (lead-in, no key), then MENU to the top-level menu - the first two steps of every codeplug-less navigation script.
menu-from-standby.source: docs/qemu-workflow.md 'A generic codeplug' example keyseq; tests/test_image_snake.py (SNAKE_KEYSEQ first steps)

long-back-channel-mode.description: With the generic codeplug: long-press Back (3000 holds) switches the A side to channel mode, MENU, then Menu > Zone > 'Zone List 1/3' > Zone-Ana > Channel List ('Channel 10'..'Channel 16'). Frames end at F14:12763 (channel-mode standby) with menu frames 11530/11385/10669/11295/10773.
